items.question: How far ahead should we book?
items.answer: I do book up, so the sooner you reach out, the better! That said, I'm always happy to work with last-minute bookings if I'm available, so don't hesitate to ask.

items.question: How do we reserve our date?
items.answer: Fill out the booking form on my site. It shows a calendar of open dates, and I'll get back to you within 24-48 hours. When we've settled the details, you sign the contract online. Your date is held once we've both signed and the retainer has come in.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: A 50% retainer is due when you sign. It reserves your date just for you, and it's non-refundable. The other 50% is due 30 days before your wedding. You can pay by credit or debit card through my secure online payment system, or with cash, check, Venmo, or Zelle.

items.question: What's included in your packages?
items.answer: Every ceremony package comes with up to 30 minutes of music while guests arrive, music for the wedding party entrance, bridal entrance, and recessional, and up to three custom song requests. Solo violin packages include sound amplification for the violin. The violin and guitar duo packages include sound equipment and wireless mics for the couple and officiant. You can add cocktail hour to either one. Prices start at $450 for solo violin ceremony, $1,000 for solo violin ceremony + cocktail hour, $1,000 for the duo ceremony, $1,500 for the duo ceremony + cocktail hour, and $3,000 for the full wedding with DJ.

items.question: Can you play our song?
items.answer: Yes! Up to three custom songs for the ceremony are included at no extra charge, arranged for your package's instruments (solo violin or violin and guitar). Please send requests at least 30 days before the wedding. Custom arrangements beyond those three, or ones you want specifically for cocktail hour, may cost extra. A song that just doesn't work for the instruments is one I may suggest swapping out.

items.question: What do you play during cocktail hour?
items.answer: Cocktail hour music is picked with you from my repertoire: classical, jazz, Celtic, folk, pop, and more. With the duo, that also includes bossa nova and tango. Tell me the styles you like and any favorite songs.

items.question: Do you bring your own sound equipment and microphones?
items.answer: Yes. I bring the instruments and the sound equipment your package needs. The duo packages include wireless mics for the couple and officiant, and I'll coordinate where they go with you and the venue. If your venue has sound restrictions, please let me know ahead of time.

items.question: What do you need from us or the venue for setup?
items.answer: Just a safe, fairly level spot to play, time to get into the venue for setup and breakdown, and power nearby if we're using sound equipment. No outlet close by? I can bring a portable battery to power the sound system. Just let me know ahead of time. I come early so everything is set and sound-checked before your guests arrive. If I'll be on-site for more than four hours in a row, please plan a meal and drinks for me (and my duo partner).

items.question: Can you play at an outdoor wedding? What if the weather is bad?
items.answer: Absolutely. I've done plenty of outdoor setups. To protect the instruments, I can't play in rain, extreme heat, high wind, or direct sun that could damage the violin. Please have a covered or indoor backup spot ready, just in case.

items.question: Do you travel?
items.answer: Yes! I'm based in San Luis Obispo and play weddings all over SLO County, the Central Coast, and beyond. Travel fees apply outside San Luis Obispo County. I'll quote yours and we'll agree on it in writing before you sign.

items.question: How long do you play, and can we add more time?
items.answer: Each package covers the times we agree on in your contract, for example 30 minutes before the ceremony plus about an hour of cocktail music. If you'd like me to stay longer on the day, I can when my schedule allows: $200 per hour for solo violin (billed by the half hour), or $300 per hour for the duo and $200 per hour for DJ. Please note that ceremony or vendor delays don't automatically extend the contracted time.

items.question: What if we need to cancel or reschedule?
items.answer: Life happens! Cancellations need to be in writing (email works). The retainer is non-refundable. If you cancel more than 90 days before the wedding, I refund 50% of anything you've paid beyond the retainer. At 90 days or less, payments aren't refunded. If you need a new date, I'll do my best to make it work. If I'm free, what you've paid can move to the new date.

items.question: Do you play events besides weddings?
items.answer: Yes! Along with proposals, where I can surprise your special someone with solo violin or the violin–guitar duo at just the right moment, I play birthdays, anniversaries, corporate events, and memorials. Private events work the same way as weddings: a 50% retainer to reserve the date, with the balance due 30 days before the event.

items.question: How much experience do you have?
items.answer: I've been performing on violin for over 20 years, playing weddings for over 10, and teaching for over 10. My Google reviews are 5.0 stars across 9 reviews.

items.question: Do you offer a DJ or a full-wedding package?
items.answer: Yes. The Full Wedding + DJ package (starting at $3,000) covers the ceremony, cocktail hour, dinner DJ, and reception dance party, with professional speakers and mics, optional MC services, and full coordination with your wedding planner.
